chunks: And whatever is in it from Yusuf al-Tatari, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Yusuf ibn Ibrahim al-Tatari.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the author's immediate source in this sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a term indicating direct narration in the chain
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, a transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ: Muhammad ibn Sinan, a transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.يُوسُفَ الطَّاطَرِيِّ: Yusuf al-Tatari, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Yusuf al-Tatari in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Yusuf al-Tatari. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission for hadith authentication and source tracing in Shia hadith literature.
